get.description:
The criteria evaluation for one patient, as of their cutoff (US-010-1).

Every criterion name, point item, points value and the referral threshold
comes from the active condition pack; the evidence behind a met item is
pre-cutoff only, and an unknown item is never counted into the total.

get.description:
Liveness and readiness: {status, db, cache, queue}, per the API spec.

Unauthenticated and always reachable, so a probe can tell a process that
is up from a Postgres or Redis that is down. The active dataset version
belongs to the administrator page (`GET /api/admin/settings`), not here.

AcceptInviteRequest.title: AcceptInviteRequest
AcceptInviteRequest.description:
The password the patient chooses. `new_password` is accepted as the
same field, and an account may be created without a usable password.
